summary: Radar for 2026-10-27 (GLP-1 focus). Nothing today qualifies for Lane C. The only new randomized result with a semaglutide arm is the UBT251 Cell Metabolism paper (Oct 26), but its topline was first reported in March 2026. That fails the 48-hour first-report rule, so it becomes a 13:00 Short. The best openings this week are Lane A practical tirzepatide long-forms with a fresh hook: (1) nutrient gaps on tirzepatide (protein, vitamin D, B12, iron, fibre). The Independent covered this Oct 26 and it is backed by a Clinical Obesity 2026 narrative review covering about 480,825 adults; it is the natural refresh for 'Protein on Tirzepatide'. (2) Hair loss, refreshed by a Med Sci (Basel) systematic review of skin side effects (Oct 9) and a July 2026 matched cohort. (3) Bones and muscle (Arch Osteoporos systematic review, Oct 23; seen in 5 snapshots). (4) Stopping tirzepatide (SURMOUNT-4, persistence data, and a new randomized semaglutide trial showing effects fade after stopping). Retatrutide for sleep apnea is peaking: Gizmodo and Medscape picked it up again on Oct 26. Use it only as a loop-ending Short with a 'what's confirmed?' fact. Plan ahead for two dates: Lilly Q3 results on Oct 29 (retatrutide filing now Q1 2027, EloraTZP Phase 3 starting Q4) as a Short, and the CagriSema FDA decision due in Q4 2026, which becomes a Lane C slot only if it lands with label numbers. Seasonal: Thanksgiving on tirzepatide peaks around Nov 18–27. Rejected: microdosing, sourcing guides for 'research' retatrutide, and the NAD+/peptide clinic trend. Mark ACOG pregnancy guidance, eating-disorder coverage and the MS observational data as 'caution'.

candidates.topic: Nutrient gaps on tirzepatide: protein, vitamin D, B12, iron and fibre. The Independent (Oct 26) plus the Clinical Obesity 2026 narrative review of about 480,825 adults
candidates.angle: Lane A long-form: 'Tirzepatide and Nutrients: What You Might Be Missing'. Open on 'you're eating half what you used to, so here's what can quietly drop' and answer in the first 15 s: protein first, then vitamin D, B12, iron and fibre. Frame it calmly as 'linked to' (the data are observational). Give practical food-first habits and say 'ask your clinician whether blood tests make sense for you'. No supplement dosing. It doubles as the playbook's 'Protein on Tirzepatide' slot.

candidates.topic: What happens when you stop tirzepatide? SURMOUNT-4 regain, the real-world persistence data (Diabetes Obes Metab, Oct 19), and a new double-blind Phase 2b RCT showing semaglutide's effects fade after stopping (Open Forum Infect Dis, Oct 5)

Open on 'you're wondering what happens if you stop' and give the answer: on average, most people regain much of the weight within a year off treatment, which is why it is treated as a long-term medicine. Use SURMOUNT-4's exact arms (783 began the lead-in, then 335 versus 335 were randomized at week 36). Give habits that help, and say plainly: don't stop or change your medicine on your own. Fix the L1 10-27 hold issues: short number sentences, and the disclaimer card on screen at its beat.
